gloss: enough for the number of people; per-person portion

definitions.gloss: enough for the number of people; per-person portion; for everyone in the group
definitions.explanation: An amount or quantity sufficient for all the people present or involved. The suffix {分|ぶん} (portion, share) attaches to {人数|にんずう} (number of people) to indicate that something is prepared or available in the right quantity for the group.

examples.japanese: {人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}のコピーを{用意|ようい}した。
{人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}の{椅子|いす}が{足|た}りない。
examples.english: There aren't enough chairs for everyone.

examples.japanese: {食材|しょくざい}は{人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}より{少|すこ}し{多|おお}めに{買|か}っておいたほうがいい。
examples.english: It's better to buy slightly more ingredients than needed for the number of people.

notes:
A compound of {人数|にんずう} (number of people) and {分|ぶん} (portion, share, amount for). The {分|ぶん} suffix is very productive: {一人|ひとり}{分|ぶん} (one person's portion), {二人|ふたり}{分|ぶん} (for two people), {三日|みっか}{分|ぶん} (three days' worth).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}を{用意|ようい}する: to prepare enough for everyone
- {人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}の{食事|しょくじ}: meals for the whole group
- {人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}{以上|いじょう}: more than enough for the group
- {人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}{足|た}りる: to be enough for the number of people

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一人|ひとり}{分|ぶん}: one person's portion — a specific single serving
- {全員|ぜんいん}{分|ぶん}: for all members — emphasizes that every single member is included
- {頭数|あたまかず}: headcount — focuses on counting the people rather than the portions
